changes.before: Would require monthly reporting to CEC on data center location, floor area, electrical capacity, water and energy consumption, PUE, WUE, onsite generation, generator fuel, procurement, and noise; local agencies would receive data at permitting stage.

Includes specified facility exclusions and disclosure protections.

changes.before: California Technology Innovation and Ratepayer Protection Act; would require CPUC tariff for participating data center customers, cost responsibility for transmission upgrades, early termination fees, clean-energy procurement, demand response participation, and no cost shifting to nonparticipating customers.
changes.after: Requires CPUC by 2028-01-01 to establish or update tariffs and electric rules for participating customers, including protections against cost shifts and a transmission-level interconnection tariff with cost responsibility and early termination terms. Section 945.3 applies to data centers entering new transmission-level retail service interconnection agreements on or after 2027-01-01; demand response participation is optional.

This combines environmental review requirements with conditional judicial streamlining.
